author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: slanted sleeve blocks, a pinched waist, and collar flaps drawn as closed triangles, so the outline read as a robot or a vest. After: a clean shirt outline (sloped shoulders, short sleeves with level cuffs, straight body) with the collar opening dipping to a V and a short placket below it, as in the reference.
omissions: The folded polo collar band is simplified to a V collar opening: separate collar flaps come within 8 of the placket and the shoulder lines.
